feedbackMechanism.howToSendFeedback: Call or text 0915-872-7722, email legpermit2@gmail.com, or fill up the Feedback Form. Clients are given a form for each service they use.
feedbackMechanism.howFeedbackIsProcessed: The assigned officer collects the forms at the end of each transaction day and submits them to the Administrative Officer for recording. They are collated quarterly and averaged into the rating clients gave for each service, presented as the Client Satisfaction Measurement Report, then submitted to the City Human Resource Management Office for the Harmonized CSM Report that goes to the Anti-Red Tape Authority. Complaints may be filed in writing or in person: write to the head of office, email legbplo@gmail.com, or call or text 0915-872-7722. The head of office asks the officer concerned to verify the complaint, then acts on it as a light or grave offence depending on what was done, with the City Human Resource Management Office applying sanctions where it is called on to assist. A client who asks for the action in writing is given it.
